family.tagline: Two parents, a six-year-old and one Companion Core in a small cottage.
family.story: Beatriz coordinates a local charity from the desk in the family bedroom. Tiago stays home with Leo, who is six. One Companion Core serves the whole cottage.

companion.name: Tuppence
companion.job: Drafts emails to the charity’s volunteers from Beatriz’s notes.
companion.limits: Drafts only. Beatriz reads and sends every message.

companion.name: Dumpling
companion.job: Drafts Tiago’s replies to school and playdate messages.
companion.limits: Drafts only. Tiago reads and sends every reply.

popup.title: Tiago finds the parcel waiting
popup.body: Up the cottage steps, a Companion Core waits by the door. Tiago carries it to the bedroom, where Beatriz clears the desk.

popup.title: Leo carries the quick-start guide
popup.body: The parcel holds the Companion Core, a power cable, a quick-start guide and a recovery USB drive. Leo carries the guide, and Tiago lifts out the Core.

popup.title: Leo presses the button
popup.body: Beatriz plugs the cable in at the desk, and Leo presses the button. The Core wakes and opens its own Wi-Fi network.

popup.title: Join it from a phone
popup.body: Tiago opens the Wi-Fi settings on his phone and joins the Core’s own network. Then he chooses the home network.

popup.title: Pick the first agent and apps
popup.body: In the Companion Hub store, Beatriz picks Hermes, and the family adds Yuvomi and KitchenOwl. Then the family walks away.

beats.capability: talks to you through the messaging platform you pick, on your Core

popup.title: Tuppence says hello
popup.body: Beatriz messages the agent she named Tuppence. Tuppence answers from the Core beside her.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: beatriz
say.text: Hello, Beatriz. I am Tuppence. Where shall we begin?

beats.capability: talks to you through the messaging platform you pick, on your Core

popup.title: Beatriz reads the draft, then sends
popup.body: A volunteer drops out of Thursday’s rota. Beatriz jots two lines and Tuppence drafts the email on the Core’s local model. Beatriz reads it, then sends it herself.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: beatriz
say.text: Draft ready. Check the names before you send it.

beats.capability: listen to your audiobooks and podcasts, and pick up where you left off

popup.title: The story starts where it stopped
popup.body: After lunch, Leo climbs the loft bed for story time. Audiobookshelf starts the next chapter where he stopped, from audiobooks kept on the Core.

beats.capability: a PDF toolkit that runs in your browser

popup.title: Three scans become one form
popup.body: On the edge of the bed, Beatriz joins the swimming lesson form’s three scans into one file. BentoPDF runs in her browser, from the Core.

beats.capability: track every subscription you pay for and get a reminder before it renews

popup.title: The broadband renewal gets a reminder
popup.body: Before the broadband renews, Wallos on the Core sends Beatriz a reminder. She typed the household’s renewals in herself, so she decides what stays.

beats.capability: turn text into natural speech on your own Core

popup.title: Leo hears the snail story
popup.body: After school, Leo asks for the snail story Tiago made up at breakfast. Tiago typed it, and Kokoro on the Core speaks it while Leo plays in the tent.

beats.capability: control and automate your smart home from one place, locally

popup.title: The puzzle gets better light
popup.body: On a grey afternoon, Leo says his puzzle needs more light. Tiago brings the floor lamp and the table lamp up as one scene in Home Assistant on the Core.

beats.capability: block ads, trackers and bad domains on your network at the DNS level

popup.title: Tiago points the router at Pi-hole
popup.body: Saturday morning, Leo watches a nature programme from the couch. Tiago has set the router to ask Pi-hole first, which blocks ad and tracker domains for devices that use it.

beats.capability: stream your own movies, shows and music to every screen in the house

popup.title: Leo watches himself learn to walk
popup.body: On Sunday, Beatriz sits down beside Leo. Jellyfin plays the family’s home videos from the Core to the TV, starting with Leo learning to walk.

beats.capability: a shared grocery list, recipe book, meal planner and expense tracker for the household

popup.title: The milk goes on the list
popup.body: The milk is nearly gone, so Tiago adds it in KitchenOwl. Beatriz adds oat biscuits from the desk, and the one shared list lives on the Core.

beats.capability: a family planner with a shared calendar, tasks, shopping, meals

popup.title: The school trip moves shopping day
popup.body: Beatriz puts the school trip in Yuvomi, the family calendar on the Core. At the breakfast bar, Tiago moves the shopping day to Wednesday.

beats.capability: store every password in a vault you host; works with the Bitwarden apps

popup.title: The school sign-in joins the vault
popup.body: The school portal wants a new sign-in. Beatriz saves it in the VaultWarden vault on the Core. Tiago finds it through the Bitwarden apps on his phone.

beats.capability: talks to you through the messaging platform you pick, on your Core

popup.title: Tiago chooses which playdate to accept
popup.body: Two playdate invitations land for one Friday. Tiago tells Dumpling which to accept, and Dumpling drafts both replies on the Core’s local model. Tiago reads both, then sends them himself.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: tiago
say.text: Both replies are ready. Shall I make either one warmer?

beats.capability: a shared grocery list, recipe book, meal planner and expense tracker for the household

popup.title: Leo chooses supper from the book
popup.body: On Tuesday, Leo chooses bean chilli from the recipe book in KitchenOwl on the Core. Tiago reads the steps while the hob warms, and Leo hands him the tins.

beats.capability: back up, search and organise your family photos and videos

popup.title: A snail gets its picture taken
popup.body: Leo finds a snail on the path, and Tiago takes its picture. The photo backs up to Immich on the Core, not to a photo cloud.

beats.capability: track your plants, watering and care history across rooms and beds

popup.title: Leo finds the fern a corner
popup.body: After the rain, a new fern comes home in a pot. Leo picks the shady corner by the fence, and Tiago logs the spot in HortusFox on the Core.

popup.title: One cottage, one Core
popup.body: Rotas, renewals, shopping lists and a snail story read aloud run on one Companion Core in a small cottage.

closing.body: Your calendar, shopping list and sign-ins can run on a Companion Core at home. Browse the Companion Hub store for your first apps.

notes: The only desk is the Core’s own, in the family bedroom. Beatriz’s desk beats anchor on the Core; the bed beats use the double bed and the loft bed. No second desk, no bookshelf, no fireplace.

Leo has no screen of his own: his beats sit at the play tent, the kids table and the loft bed, and an adult sits with him. kids-snail is Kokoro (no replaces chip); the text never says what plays the sound.
Both companions are Hermes. Beatriz and Tiago message the agent through the chat service the family picks; the note rides on the ftue and on each agent beat.
BentoPDF runs in the browser (listing: nothing is uploaded). The beat says it runs from the Core and never claims the saved file lands anywhere.
Wallos fetches logos from outside (catalog caveat); no beat says nothing leaves the Core and no beat promises savings.
Pi-hole covers only devices that use it for DNS; the beat says so and does not call it parental control.
kids-lamps: the Kids Zone has a floor lamp and a table lamp. Home Assistant controls network devices only (no Zigbee claim, no cloud-account claim about the lamps).
garden-snail and garden-water anchor on the back patios (role deck), beside the stepping path, the fern and hosta borders and the privacy fence; the front beds are only the fallback.
